issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I correction asking that Bulk Data Formats on the STU3-era FHIR-core-formats section 2.6.0.1.4.1 be declared non-normative.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 14248. The matching git-svn commit c186eb68d4e1ad666db113ba8611651919b0ce38 mentioned GF#16997/GF#16425 and wrapped the Bulk Data Formats subsection in draft-content with a draft warning. The later FHIR-18448 page split moved that applied material into source/resource-formats.html while preserving the warning at that time.
additional_context: FHIR-16425 requested the same section be flagged Informative, and FHIR-16500 separately made the NDJSON page non-normative/STU in 2018. Later R6 work changed status deliberately: commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the draft warning from source/resource-formats.html and changed source/nd-json.html from Draft to Normative. FHIR-I 2025-09 WGM minutes record the R6 review noting JSON and NDJSON were already normative.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding a non-normative warning now would reverse later R6 normative-status work rather than complete the 2018 issue.
